title: Help Center: /help built to its canvas, and members' tickets in it (D599)
Edit a posted issue before anyone is assigned
body:
## Context

Once a maintainer posts an issue, its title, description and criteria can't be changed. Typos and unclear criteria stay forever.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each issue in "Issues & proposals" has an Edit action that opens the post form pre-filled.
- [ ] Title, description, criteria and complexity can be edited while no proposal is `Assigned`, `PR submitted` or `Paid`.
- [ ] The bounty amount is **not** editable here, because it is escrowed. Point to top-up (#6) instead.
- [ ] After assignment, Edit is disabled with a reason.
- [ ] The smoke test covers editing a title.

## Complexity

Medium

## Pointers

- `src/pages/maintainer.tsx`: `RepoIssues`, `PostIssueForm`

title: Add a short demo GIF of the full bounty flow to the README
body:
## Context

The README has static screenshots. A 20–30 second clip of a bounty going from posted to paid would explain the product faster than any paragraph.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record the flow from README "Try the full flow locally": post an issue, apply, assign, submit PR, merge and release, receipt appears.
- [ ] Export as an optimised GIF or MP4 under 5 MB in `docs/assets/`, at a readable size (around 1200px wide).
- [ ] Embed it near the top of `README.md`, with alt text describing the flow.
- [ ] Use the dark theme and seeded demo data. No real personal data in the recording.

## Complexity

Trivial

## Pointers

- `README.md`: "Try the full flow locally"
- `docs/assets/`

title: [Bounty: $120] Cap contribution_amount so pooled arithmetic cannot overflow and lock funds
body:
## Context

The Group constructor rejects only `contribution_amount <= 0` (`group/src/lib.rs:346`); the Factory does the same (`factory/src/lib.rs:196-198`). `contribute` accumulates with `pool.checked_add(amount)` (`lib.rs:516-519`). With no cap, a group can use `amount = i128::MAX, capacity = 2`: the first contribution succeeds, the second always returns `ArithmeticOverflow` (518), the round never becomes `ReadyForPayout`, and `execute_payout` permanently returns `ContributionsIncomplete` (578). With no withdrawal path, the first member's funds are irrecoverably locked.

## Proposed Change

Validate that `contribution_amount.checked_mul(member_capacity as i128)` is `Some(_)` (or enforce a `MAX_CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT`) in both constructors, returning `InvalidContributionAmount`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A constructor test rejects any `(amount, capacity)` whose pooled sum overflows `i128`
- A normal group is unaffected

**Suggested Label:** security
**ETA:** 48 hours

title: [Bounty: $130] Add a malicious/reentrant-token test for contribute and execute_payout
body:
## Context

`contribute` (`group/src/lib.rs:512-539`) and `execute_payout` (602-626) document reentrancy safety via checks-effects-interactions, but every test uses the standard Stellar Asset Contract (`test.rs:90-92`, `deploy_group.rs:50-52`). The Group constructor accepts an arbitrary token (`lib.rs:361`) and the Factory forwards a caller-supplied token (`factory/src/lib.rs:182,218-230`), so a malicious token is a realistic, entirely untested adversary.

## Proposed Change

Add a test-only malicious token contract that re-enters `contribute`/`execute_payout`; assert no double contribution or double payout and correct final balances.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A test demonstrates the reentrant token cannot cause a duplicate contribution or payout

**Suggested Label:** testing
**ETA:** 72 hours
